text.en:
Item (f) on page 440, subparagraph 38, for the Province of Negros Oriental, Group I, paragraph d, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and one, is amended to read as follows:
"(f) La Libertad-Pacuan Road Construction and/or improvement ₱10,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
